breakdown.description: The 2D line traction on the top edge is reinterpreted as a 3D surface pressure
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The generated specification repeats the incorrect interpretation from the original prompt, stating to 'Interpret the top-edge traction as a 3D pressure of 2000 Pa...'. The ground truth explicitly corrects this to be interpreted as a '2D line traction per unit out-of-plane thickness', removing the erroneous 'pressure' concept entirely. The agent's output is contradictory and does not align with the ground truth's correction.
